Comment: ABS is zero-marked; ERG suffix -lu/-ju is the only core case marker. Confirmed by McKelson Lesson 39-40.
1SG takes ERG suffix -lu when transitive subject (ngajulu); bare ngaju for intransitive S.
2SG nyuntu takes -lu as transitive subject: nyuntulu kawa mayi walipikarti 'You take the tucker' (Lesson 5, p.6).
3rd person full NPs take -lu/-ju as transitive subjects: wakalalu jinkanu jurru 'the woman hit the snake' (Lesson 39, p.39). Demonstrative pronouns also take -lu in A role.
Full NPs take ERG suffix -lu (after vowels) / -ju (after consonants): wakalalu (woman-ERG), wilarrju (turtle-ERG). McKelson p.39-40 explicitly explains the rule.
